title: install_steps: fix sandbox write path resolution

Assisted by Antigravity (Google DeepMind) for codebase investigation and drafting the RSpec unit test. All changes, Sorbet typing, and specs were personally reviewed, verified locally via `./bin/brew style`, `./bin/brew typecheck`, and `./bin/brew tests`, and confirmed end-to-end with live cask installs on Linux.

-----

### What this change does
Resolves the parent directory for `inreplace` and `change_dylib_id` step paths in `Homebrew::InstallSteps::Runner#sandbox_write_paths`.

### Why this change is needed
On Linux, Homebrew prepares writable sandbox paths via Landlock (`Sandbox::LinuxBackend#prepare_writable_path`). Any path registered as a `:subpath` write rule that does not yet exist is pre-created using `FileUtils.mkdir_p`.

When an install step declares `inreplace` or `change_dylib_id` on a file that has not yet been extracted (for instance, inside `preflight_steps` before extracting an RPM via `cpio` or a Debian package via `dpkg-deb`), `sandbox_write_paths` previously returned the target file path itself. As a result, Landlock pre-created the file path as an empty directory before extraction began.

When extraction runs, tools like `cpio` refuse to overwrite the existing directory (`not created: newer or same age version exists`), leaving the empty directory in place. Subsequent `inreplace` calls fail when attempting to read the directory as a file: `Errno::EISDIR: Is a directory @ io_fread`.

Returning `.parent` aligns `inreplace` and `change_dylib_id` with other file-modifying steps (like `write`, `touch`, and `move`), ensuring Landlock only prepares the enclosing directory.

### Step-by-step reproduction (on Linux)
1. Install an RPM-based cask that extracts and replaces a desktop file in `preflight_steps`:
   `brew install --cask ublue-os/experimental-tap/webex-linux`
2. Fails during extraction:
   ```text
   /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/cpio: ./opt/Webex/bin/webex.desktop not created: newer or same age version exists
   Error: ublue-os/experimental-tap/webex-linux: An exception occurred within a child process:
     Errno::EISDIR: Is a directory @ io_fread - .../opt/Webex/bin/webex.desktop
   ```
3. With this change applied, `webex.desktop` is not pre-created, extraction succeeds, and installation completes cleanly.

### Test coverage
Added unit test in `Library/Homebrew/test/install_steps_spec.rb`:
- `resolves parent directory for inreplace and change_dylib_id sandbox write paths`
